runnerCompletedDefinition: every recorded item was processed; false when any item stayed not-run. It says nothing about whether the observations passed.
compatibilityMetDefinition: official mode only, and every required observation is confirmed. A required item that is limited, unavailable, not-run, or failed keeps it false; a fixture run is always false. It does not certify migration or deleting the fork: the base spec keeps the existing agent dir write-back and persistent settings write unproven, and those stay outside the required list. It also says nothing about whether role, /clear, or /model is available: the matrix item is confirmed as soon as any purpose is observed, so read its observed purpose count instead.
